question: Classify all sign lifts of the native quarter-clock representation on the ordered four-punctured sphere, and determine their actual extension classes and native quartic/exterior cohomology.
scope: Pure mathematics. Full sign-lift preimage of <J> with all four peripheral projections J, prescribed ordered peripheral conjugacy classes and simultaneous conjugation by that preimage. Full factor table on native <J,R>=C4xC2. Not unrestricted G31/W(E8) reflection moduli, a global splitting theorem, a mapping-class quotient or classification of spatial-reflection-equivariant lifts.
new_theorems: Peripheral-profile existence iff sum ui=0; normal forms give256classes for diagonal profiles and128otherwise.
526336total conjugacy classes, with exact orbit/stabilizer and image-order census.
Central quotient class restricts to zero exactly on subgroups contained in the designated F2^4 hyperplane;32central characters yield16marked U1 classes.
Native J and JR associated quartic/exterior local systems are distinguished by local-coefficient cohomology.
standard_tools_reused: Cellular cohomology of a bouquet of three circles
kills: Interpreting every sign-lift factor as a scalar central multiplier.
Determining a four-puncture representation solely from its four peripheral conjugacy classes.
Identifying J and JR transport on native exterior/quartic spaces merely from their equal order.
